school_kid_m.name: Schoolboy
dialog: There are coloured shards hidden all over Sinnoh: red, blue, yellow and green.
The man in that house over there is always asking for them. I'm collecting them for him!

lady.name: Lady
dialog: The rain hardly ever lets up along this stretch of road.
Still, it keeps everything so lovely and green. I suppose it's worth getting wet for.

collector.name: Collector
dialog: Pastoria City is just ahead, and past it the Great Marsh.
Collectors like me come from all over Sinnoh for the Pokémon that live in that mud.

trainer.name: Juan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Juan: The fish bite best in the rain, and so do I. Let's battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Juan: Soaked to the skin and beaten as well. Still, the fishing's good.

trainer.name: Josh
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Josh: Two Goldeen on a single line, that's my record! Want to meet them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Josh: Back into the water with you both. You've done your best.

trainer.name: Travis
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Travis: Hey! You splashed right past my float. Now you owe me a battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Travis: All right, all right. I'll go and find a quieter pond.

trainer.name: Taylor
trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Taylor: Rangers look after Pokémon and the places they live. Let's see how you look after yours!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Taylor: Your Pokémon trust you. That much is plain to see.

trainer.name: Allison
trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Allison: I patrol this marsh in all weathers. A bit of rain never stopped a Ranger!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Allison: Well! That's going in my patrol report.

trainer.name: Jeffrey
trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Jeffrey: Halt! Every trainer on this road gets a Ranger's inspection.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Jeffrey: Inspection passed, with flying colours.

trainer.name: Danny
trainer.dialogueBefore: Policeman Danny: Hold it there! Routine check. I'll need a look at your Pokémon, in battle.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Policeman Danny: All in order. Mind how you go on these wet roads.

trainer.name: Stefano
trainer.dialogueBefore: Scientist Stefano: I study how Pokémon battle in the rain. You'll make an excellent subject!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Scientist Stefano: Remarkable. I must write this down before the ink runs.

trainer.name: Dean
trainer.dialogueBefore: Collector Dean: Behold my pride and joy: one Pokémon of the sun and one of the moon!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Collector Dean: The sun and the moon, both beaten at once... I shall go and polish their Poké Balls.

trainer.name: Shaun
trainer.dialogueBefore: Scientist Shaun: Does a Magnemite rust in the rain? An experiment is in order!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Scientist Shaun: Hypothesis: you are the stronger trainer. Result: confirmed.

trainer.name: Alexa
trainer.dialogueBefore: Parasol Lady Alexa: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter. What could be nicer than a battle in the rain?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Parasol Lady Alexa: Well, my parasol kept me dry, at least.

trainer.name: Sabrina
trainer.dialogueBefore: Parasol Lady Sabrina: My Wooper jumps in every puddle it finds. Shall we make a splash too?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Parasol Lady Sabrina: Oh, how very drippy of me. Off you go, then.

signs.arrow_signpost:
Route 212
East: Pastoria City
North-west: Hearthome City
signs.signboard_shards_wanted:
Shards Wanted!
Bring me coloured shards, and I'll teach your Pokémon a new move in return.
signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
Rain makes Water-type moves stronger and Fire-type moves weaker. Plan your team around the weather!
